mapper.select: SELECT EMAIL ,PROVIDER ,INS_DAY FROM T_USER WHERE 1=1 AND NICKNAME = #{nickname} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID AS USER_ID ,EMAIL ,PROVIDER FROM T_USER WHERE 1=1 AND EMAIL = #{email} AND DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY ID LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_EMAIL_VERIFY WHERE 1=1 AND EMAIL = #{email} AND INS_DAY > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 minute'

SELECT ID AS VERIFY_ID ,CODE ,VERIFY_YN ,CASE WHEN EXPIRE_DAY < NOW() THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXPIRED_YN FROM T_EMAIL_VERIFY WHERE 1=1 AND EMAIL = #{email} AND PURPOSE = 'RESET' AND DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE T_EMAIL_VERIFY SET VERIFY_YN = 'Y' ,VERIFY_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{verifyId}
UPDATE T_USER SET PASSWORD = #{password} ,UPT_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND ID = #{userId} AND PROVIDER = 'LOCAL' AND DEL_DAY IS NULL
